clue.text: Leading journalist, entering motorway, needing a means of communication

indicators.note: the journalist goes into the motorway's name, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI in letters
a newspaper's leading journalist is its editor, ED

explanation.surface: A top reporter joins the motorway traffic, needing some way to file the story.
explanation.walkthrough: Britain's M1 motorway gives MI (the figure 1 read as the letter I); ED goes inside it, then A follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Press, radio and television together are the mass channels by which news reaches the public.

clue.text: Promises to pay after endless strain -music to the ears!

indicators.note: the promissory notes come after the trimmed tune in the answer
the tune's word loses its last letter, having no end

parts.note: a strain is a tune or melody
an IOU is a written promise to pay a debt; IOUS is the plural

explanation.surface: After a long stretch of hardship, pledges of payment are welcome news.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tuneful and pleasant to hear is exactly what music to the ears describes, an idiom for delight.

clue.text: Find good university in Bath

indicators.note: the two abbreviations are placed inside the word for a bath

parts.note: a bath can be a dip, a quick immersion

explanation.surface: Locating a fine university in the English city of Bath.
explanation.walkthrough: Bath is an English university city, which makes the capital look like a place name; here it is just a dip.
explanation.definitionFit: To unearth or discover something is a phrasal synonym for finding it.

clue.text: Unusual rail, one that's seen on the wing

indicators.note: an unusual arrangement of the letters signals that they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A strange railing, one spotted out on the wing of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: The hinged flap on an aircraft wing controlling roll is mounted on the wing's trailing edge.

clue.text: Maybe giving out hiding

explanation.surface: Perhaps handing something over while also concealing it.
explanation.definitionFit: Glands discharge substances, a sense of giving out; separately the verb means to hide something away.

clue.text: One has very little space inside reserved for dance

indicators.note: the pieces go within the word for reserved

parts.note: someone reserved is shy
one is I, the Roman numeral
MM, millimetres, measures a very small distance

explanation.surface: Someone with hardly any room keeps a quiet, reserved manner while dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: A shimmy is a dance in which the body shakes, popular in the 1920s.

clue.text: New coal and oil development in settlements abroad

indicators.note: a development reshapes the letters into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Fresh coal and oil exploitation is going on in overseas outposts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'development' rearranges N (from 'New') with COAL and OIL.
explanation.definitionFit: Colonies are settlements abroad, so the adjective describes what belongs to or happens in them.

clue.text: Troubled, maybe, about heartless spies in Foreign 'Office

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the other piece
troubled letters are stirred up and rearranged
spies with its heart removed keeps only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Something is perhaps wrong concerning agents gone soft at the foreign ministry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Troubled' rearranges MAYBE into EMBAY, and 'about' puts it round SS, the first and last letters of 'spies' ('heartless'). The apostrophe before Office is a print stray.
explanation.definitionFit: A country's official mission in a foreign capital is its office abroad, headed by an ambassador.

clue.text: Shy type, one wandering in home and dry

parts.note: to be in is to be at home

indicators.note: the wanderer goes inside the abbreviation for dry

parts.note: TT, teetotal, describes someone who stays dry
a rover is one who wanders

explanation.surface: A timid person, a wanderer, stays at home and off the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: An introvert is a reserved, inward-looking person, the classic shy type.

clue.text: Grounds for clergyman's delight, as bishop enters

indicators.note: the bishop's letter goes into the word for delight

parts.note: glee is delight
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A vicar has reason to be pleased when his bishop walks in.
explanation.definitionFit: Glebe is land attached to a parish benefice, giving the clergyman income or use.

clue.text: Permitted advertisement for " professional charges.

parts.note: something permitted by law is legal
a bill is a poster advertising something

explanation.surface: A lawful poster announcing what a lawyer charges.
explanation.definitionFit: A solicitor's account for work done is the invoice of fees owed to a legal professional.

clue.text: Be immersed in job, at heart

indicators.note: the letters sit within the run of clue words that follows

explanation.surface: Being absorbed in one's work at the deepest level.
explanation.definitionFit: To bathe is to soak the body in water, so to be immersed in it.

clue.text: Leave chaps to rest, dashing round shopping centre

parts.note: to depart is to leave
chaps are men

indicators.note: dashing about mixes the letters so they come out rearranged

explanation.surface: Fellows leave, rushing back home to rest after a shopping trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dashing round' rearranges TO REST into TSTORE.
explanation.definitionFit: A large store selling many kinds of goods in separate sections is a one-building place to shop.

clue.text: Establish one's position in the East

explanation.surface: Finding your bearings out in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to get one's bearings; as a noun it is a literary word for Asia and the East.

clue.text: Diamonds put down, one 'originally cut in island republic

parts.note: ice is slang for diamonds
to land something is to put it down
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: originally signals the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Gems are set down and one is first cut in a Nordic nation.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe before 'originally' is a print stray.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes what is found or spoken in the North Atlantic island republic.

clue.text: Ships prohibit importing European vegetable crop

parts.note: a navy is a nation's fleet of ships

indicators.note: the European letter is brought into the word for prohibit

parts.note: to ban is to prohibit

explanation.surface: A fleet bars foreign produce from coming in.
explanation.definitionFit: The small white haricot is a pulse grown as a field crop, named for US Navy rations.

clue.text: Using old money, had one over the 'eight, in a right old state

definitions.text: Using old money, had one over the 'eight, in a right old state

parts.words: Using old money, had one over the 'eight, in a right old state
parts.note: one over eight is the number after eight, and the old British coin sum of that many pennies figures in the saying right as that amount, here twisted to a drunken state

explanation.surface: In pre-decimal days someone had too much to drink and ended up in a terrible state.
explanation.walkthrough: Having 'one over the eight' is British slang for being drunk. The idiom 'right as ninepence' means perfectly well; the clue plays on it, and ninepence was a pre-decimal sum.
explanation.definitionFit: Nine old pence is pre-decimal money, and the number nine is literally one more than eight.

clue.text: Climber with food poisoning at first offered replacement

indicators.note: the first letter of the poisoning is swapped for another letter

parts.note: listeria is bacteria causing food poisoning

explanation.surface: A mountaineer with an upset stomach is first offered a substitute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at first offered replacement' swaps the L at the start of LISTERIA for W.
explanation.definitionFit: Wisteria is a climbing plant with hanging lilac flowers.

clue.text: Woman facing record decline in treatment of animals

parts.note: a woman is she
an EP is an extended-play record
a dip is a decline

explanation.surface: A woman faces a falling record in how livestock are cared for.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical bath in which sheep are plunged to kill parasites is a veterinary treatment.

clue.text: It's an awkward job to flatten solid metal block

parts.note: a pig of a job is a difficult task, so a pig is something awkward
to iron clothes is to flatten them

explanation.surface: Pressing a hefty lump of metal flat is tricky work.
explanation.definitionFit: Crude iron from a blast furnace is cast into oblong ingots, which is a solid lump of metal.

clue.text: Tiny item charged for by weight

parts.note: to be pro something is to be for it
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A small article is billed according to how heavy it is.
explanation.definitionFit: A subatomic particle carrying positive electric charge is very small, an item in the atom's nucleus.

clue.text: Meet charge?

explanation.surface: Encounter a fee.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet someone by chance is to bump into them; to charge something is to collide with it at speed.

clue.text: Is myth inaccurate where Vulcan was concerned?

indicators.note: inaccurate letters are not in the right order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Doubting a legend about the Roman god of fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inaccurate' rearranges IS MYTH. Vulcan was the Roman god of fire and metalworking.
explanation.definitionFit: A blacksmith's forge is the workplace of the Roman smith-god, so it is where he was busy.

clue.text: Game feliow's stylish drawing

parts.note: draughts is a board game, called checkers in America
a fellow is a man, and 's adds S
hip means stylish or fashionable

explanation.surface: A gamer's elegant sketching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feliow's' is a print misreading of fellow's.
explanation.definitionFit: Skill in technical or artistic drawing is the craft of a draughtsman.

clue.text: Refuse to sleep rough, demanding right to be inside

indicators.note: the letter for right is placed within the word for sleeping rough

parts.note: to doss is British slang for sleeping rough

explanation.surface: Declining to bed down outdoors unless one has the right to come indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Dross is waste matter, the rubbish that is refuse.

clue.text: Greeting used round small island, one in the Caribbean

indicators.note: the greeting goes around the island's word

parts.note: hi is a greeting
an ait is a small river island, as in the Thames

explanation.surface: A hello offered around a tiny isle, one in the West Indies.
explanation.definitionFit: Haiti is a country on Hispaniola, an island in the Caribbean Sea.

clue.text: Gold deposited by the German hierarchy

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
der is German for the

explanation.surface: Gold lodged by the German establishment.
explanation.definitionFit: An order is a ranked system or class structure, a hierarchy.

clue.text: Perhaps enter into holding

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters might form something else, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Maybe going inside while gripping something.
explanation.definitionFit: Retention is the act of keeping or holding on to something.

clue.text: To support a line is not so important

parts.note: to second a motion is to support it
RY, railway, is a line

explanation.surface: Backing a policy is of less consequence.
explanation.definitionFit: Something secondary is subordinate, of lesser rank or importance.

clue.text: It's present on round or pointed arch

indicators.note: the present comes on, after, the round letter

parts.note: O is round in shape
to give is to present

explanation.surface: A gift placed on a curved or pointed arch.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogive is a pointed Gothic arch or the diagonal rib of a vault.
